 A U.S. Marine with the Marine Corps Base Quantico color guard stands at parade rest during the Veterans Day wreath laying ceremony at National Memorial Cemetery at Quantico in Triangle, Virginia, Nov. 11, 2026. Veterans Day is a federal holiday observed on November 11 of each year to honor all veterans who have served in the U.S. Armed Forces. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Donovan Melendez)
